description: A Dockerfile with several FROM stages where a build stage compiles the code and only the runtime stage ends up in the final image.
A cached, read-only result of one Dockerfile instruction that Docker reuses while the instruction and everything before it are unchanged.
A Spring Boot jar indexed into dependencies, loader, snapshot dependencies and application layers that the tools jar mode can extract.
Cloud Native Buildpacks build an image from the project with spring-boot:build-image or bootBuildImage and no Dockerfile.
An unprivileged account created in the image and selected with USER so a compromised process has fewer rights.
The JVM behavior, on by default, of reading the container memory and processor limits instead of those of the host.
The JVM option that sets the maximum heap as a percentage of available memory, 25 by default.
